You see a fridge. What a letdown! The fridge is empty! An open oven, which looks conventional, is right there by you. What a letdown! The oven is empty! You see a table. You wonder idly who left that here. The table is massive. However, the table, like an empty table, has nothing on it. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the table! oh well. As if things weren't amazing enough already, you can even see a counter. On the counter you can see a red apple and a raw yellow potato, so there's that. You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a stove. However, the stove, like an empty stove, has nothing on it.

There is a closed plain door leading north. There is a closed screen door leading south. You don't like doors? Why not try going east, that entranceway is not blocked by one.

There is a carrot on the floor.
